workload-security.json.description: Native two-node mTLS trial plus retained TLS, trust, transport and violation panels. Planned instrumentation is explicitly unavailable; TCP starts are not TLS handshakes.

panels.description: Experimental scope, demonstrated paths and explicit remaining security gates.

options.content:
**Native panels: isolated cmtc-mtls fixture only.** The Cluster selector affects planned CMTC panels below. **Planned panels: not implemented; No data is expected until their stories land.**

**Two nodes · no application sidecars · no CNP / CCNP / KNP.** Native authentication checks reject an absent verified TLS principal, without an application-port list.

**Locally tested paths:** mTLS on 80 / 8080 / 9443 and Service 18080 → 8080; unenrolled and host clients receive no HTTP response. Independent request and restart-probe results belong to the recorded run; the panels show the selected time range.

**Open gates:** effective workload authorization, creation/restore capture, platform exceptions, cross-cluster and transport composition. **Complete Protected status is not claimed.**

Not HTTP requests, successful application responses, or TLS handshakes; authenticated connections can still be denied by authorization policy.

options.content:
**Historical baseline — 2026-10-24, agent `f052d1276b`:** 6,000/6,000 HTTP 200 under mTLS load; 900/900 unenrolled attempts rejected. SPIRE outage: six retries, no false ACK, authenticated ACK after recovery. [Baseline outputs and pins](https://github.com/ephico2real2/clustermesh-trust-controller/blob/1c192a5ee84fb5218cb1385fdd9c5bf45ca69e1a/2026-10-24T0509Z-local-authenticated-only-f052d127/README.md).

**Native table:** lifetime counters, not range totals. `unknown` = no verified mesh principal; `DENY` = policy rejection; `-` = no failure flag. [Remaining acceptance: issue #8](https://github.com/ephico2real2/clustermesh-trust-controller/issues/8).
